post_topic: Health checks that lie: why a 200 OK is not a readiness signal
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

Title at top center in bold navy text: "Liveness vs. Readiness: What Your Health Check Actually Proves"

The diagram is split into two vertical columns by a thin navy divider line. Each column has a header label in a rounded rectangle at the top.

LEFT COLUMN — header label: "Shallow Liveness Check" with a red warning icon. Below the header, a vertical top-to-bottom flow:
Node 1 (rounded rect, navy border): "Load Balancer / Monitor" with a small monitor icon.
Arrow pointing down labeled "GET /health".
Node 2 (rounded rect, navy border): "App Process" with a small server icon.
Arrow pointing down labeled "HTTP 200 OK" in amber #F5A623 with a checkmark.
Node 3 (rounded rect, red border, light red fill): "Connection Pool" with label "STUCK — exhausted, not recovering".
Arrow pointing down with an X mark (red): "No DB query executed".
Node 4 (rounded rect, gray border, gray fill): "PostgreSQL / Database" with the PostgreSQL elephant logo. Label beneath: "Healthy — responds in <1s".
A callout box to the right of Node 3 in amber #F5A623: "Process is alive. Work is not happening."

RIGHT COLUMN — header label: "Proper Readiness Check" with a green checkmark icon. Below the header, a vertical top-to-bottom flow:
Node 1 (rounded rect, navy border): "Load Balancer / Monitor" with a small monitor icon.
Arrow pointing down labeled "GET /health".
Node 2 (rounded rect, navy border): "App Process" with a small server icon.
Arrow pointing down in blue #5a96ff labeled "Acquire connection from pool".
Node 3 (rounded rect, blue border, light blue fill): "Connection Pool" with label "Healthy" and a green dot.
Arrow pointing down in blue #5a96ff labeled "Execute lightweight query".
Node 4 (rounded rect, navy border): "PostgreSQL / Database" with the PostgreSQL elephant logo. Label beneath: "Round-trip < threshold".
Arrow pointing back up on the right side of the column, curved, labeled "200 OK only if all pass" in blue #5a96ff.
A second dashed arrow from Node 3 pointing right to a callout box in amber #F5A623: "Pool stuck? Return 503 immediately."

At the very bottom center of the diagram, a single summary line in navy bold text: "A heartbeat tells you the patient is breathing — not that they're functional."

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
